verified_steps: Pointwise representative f(x)=C_exp(x) is bounded/measurable; R20 height control and central limit give asymptotic uniform continuity with modulus 2A*(1-exp(-delta)).
Positive log kernel q(u)=p(exp(u))*exp(u) and reflection K(u)=q(-u) match standard convolution; reflected angular Fourier multiplier is (1+i*tau)/cosh(pi*tau/2), with no real zero.
Beta parameters have real parts 3/2 and 1/2; gamma recurrence and reflection give the exact sign and normalization.
Wiener L1 translation density applies to this integrable kernel. For fixed L1 test, density error is bounded by (||f||inf+|c|)*eta before taking eta to zero.
At fixed box-average width delta, full translated limits hold; height limit precedes delta to zero. This recovers actual pointwise values using asymptotic uniform continuity despite finite jumps.
Full real-height convergence Vbar->c iff C->c iff D->A-c, with c in [0,A] if a limit exists. This supplies no existence or arbitrary-subsequence converse.
Exact wave tests show absence of a uniform linear L-infinity inverse estimate, also in a fixed Lipschitz class after amplitude rescaling; no stronger nonlinear-instability claim is made.
